9187.meaning1: having not hesitated; having not held back; having not paused

examples.text: idha, bhikkhave, asappuriso yo hoti parassa avaṇṇo taṃ apuṭṭho'pi pātu karoti, ko pana vādo puṭṭhassa! puṭṭho kho pana pañh'ābhinīto ahāpetvā alambitvā paripūraṃ vitthārena parassa avaṇṇaṃ bhāsitā hoti.

9189.commentary: (SNa) alaso cā'ti kantanapacan'ādīni kammāni kātuṃ na sakkoti, kusīto ālasiyo nisinnaṭṭhāne nisinno'va, ṭhitaṭhāne ṭhito'va niddāyati eva.

examples.text: uṭṭhānakālamhi anuṭṭhahāno, yuvā balī ālasiyaṃ upeto, saṃsannasaṅkappamano kusīto, paññāya maggaṃ alaso na vindati.
niddāsīlī sabhāsīlī, anuṭṭhātā ca yo naro, alaso kodhapaññāṇo, taṃ parābhavato mukhaṃ.

9190.construction:
na > a + √las + a + ka
alasa + ka

examples.text: so sattamaṃ divasaṃ alasakena kālaṅ'karissati. kālaṅ'kato ca kālakañcikā nāma asurā sabbanihīno asurakāyo, tatra upapajjissati.

9191.meaning1: lazy in nature; of indolent disposition
9191.commentary: (PYt) alasajātikā'ti kosajjajātikā. (VISMa) alasajātikassā'ti sajjukam'eva taṇḍulaṃ aggahetvā paradivasass'atthāya gahaṇena alasapakatikassa.

examples.text: atha kho, vāseṭṭha, aññatarassa sattassa alasajātikassa etadahosi, ambho, kim'ev'āhaṃ vihaññāmi sāliṃ āharanto sāyaṃ sāyam'āsāya pāto pātarāsāya! yaṃnūn'āhaṃ sāliṃ āhareyyaṃ sakiṃ'd'eva sāyapātarāsāyā'ti!

9192.meaning2: lazy by nature; disposed to laziness

9194.construction:
na > a + √las + a + iya
alasa + iya

examples.text: alasv'assa anuṭṭhātā, na ca kiccāni kāraye, sabbakāmasamiddhassa, taṃ me sakka varaṃ disā'ti.

9198.meaning1: suitable for the term; appropriate to say; suitable to be called
9198.commentary: (SNa) alaṃ vacanāyā'ti, evaṃ vattabbataṃ arahati, yutto anucchaviko'ti attho

examples.text: taṃ kiṃ maññatha, bhikkhave, javano puriso paramena javena samannāgato'ti alaṃ vacanāyā'ti?
catuppadāya ce'pi, bhikkhu, gāthāya attham'aññāya dhammam'aññāya dhamm'ānudhammappaṭipanno hoti bahussuto dhammadharo'ti alaṃ vacanāyā'ti.

9199.grammar: ind, adv, emph, acc sg of ala, impers (+dat or +inf)
9199.commentary: (VINa) alañ'hi te, āvuso sudinna, kukkuccāyā'ti āvuso sudinna, tuyh'etaṃ pāpakammaṃ alaṃ samatthaṃ kukkuccāya, paṭibalaṃ kukkuccaṃ uppādetun'ti vuttaṃ hoti.

examples.text: alañ'hi vo, kālāmā, kaṅkhituṃ alaṃ vicikicchituṃ
appañ'hi etaṃ na alaṃ samāya, duve vivādassa phalāni brūmi, etam'pi disvā na vivādayetha, khem'ābhipassaṃ avivādabhūmiṃ.
